'''Feral vampyres''' appear during [[River of Blood]] after four [[Vampyre Juvinate]]s attempt to cross the [[Super Guthix balance]] blessed [[River Salve|Salve]], devolving them into their [[Feral vampyre|feral state]] and losing their immunity to most types of weaponry. One will then wander off, and the other three will begin to attack each other. The remaining three must be defeated in order to continue with the quest.
